title: Switch Valentine slideshow to a “cute boy with glasses” 11-page love story with updated intro, screens, story page, and final greeting

requirements.text: Update the slideshow flow from the current 9 screens to an 11-page flow with the following order and navigation: (Pre-intro animation) → Page 1 (HEY JAAN ❤️ + Continue) → Page 2 (fading romantic message + Continue) → Page 3 (Valentine question YES/NO behavior) → Page 4 (happy dancing boy + Continue) → Page 5 (Love Letters x6 + Continue ❤️) → Page 6 (kiss boy + Continue) → Page 7 (proposal boy with two affirmative buttons) → Page 8 (moonrise envelope + editable letter + Continue ❤️) → Page 9 (custom message + Forever yours.) → Page 10 (full animated story long-distance→love→marriage→family with 5 children) → Page 11 (final Valentine greeting + last note box).

quotes: Restructure the slideshow flow to 11 pages: intro heart animation; Page 1 “HEY JAAN ❤️” + Continue; Page 2 fading romantic message + Continue; Page 3 Valentine question YES/NO ... Page 10  -  a full animation story ... Page 11 - happy valentine day my love my future wifey and also add a note box where I can write a last note

acceptanceCriteria: The slideshow controller advances through exactly 11 pages (not counting the pre-intro overlay), and does not stop at 9.
All existing per-page transition timing behavior remains smooth and consistent with current transitions.
The slideshow still calls the provided onUserInteraction callback on any user-driven advance or answer so music autoplay gating continues to work.

requirements.text: Implement the new Page 1 welcome screen copy exactly as “HEY JAAN ❤️” (uppercase as shown) with a Continue button, replacing the existing “Hey cutie ❤️” copy.

quotes:
Page 1 – Welcome The first screen should display large cute text:
“HEY JAAN ❤️”  add continue button

acceptanceCriteria: Page 1 displays the text exactly “HEY JAAN ❤️”.
A visible Continue button advances to Page 2.

requirements.text: Keep Page 2 as a dedicated intro message page where the message “You make my world brighter every day… and I want to ask you something special.” fades in, with a Continue button to proceed.

quotes: Page 2 - ... a short romantic message fades in: “You make my world brighter every day… and I want to ask you something special.” then add continue button

acceptanceCriteria: The Page 2 message fades in after page load (or after a short delay) and matches the text exactly.
Continue advances to Page 3.

requirements.text: Update Page 3 (Valentine question) to the “cute boy with glasses” theme: on the first NO click, show an angry cartoon boy with glasses animation and the text exactly “Wrong answer! Try again 😤”, then automatically return to the question state; on the second NO attempt, fade out and disable the NO option; on YES, transition to Page 4 with a celebratory heart + stars + moon confetti-style effect.

quotes: If she clicks NO:for first time Show an angry cartoon boy with glasses animation with funny dramatic text: “Wrong answer! Try again 😤” Then automatically return to the same question screen. If she again try toh click no the no option will fade If she clicks YES: Transition to the next page with heart stars moon confetti animation.

acceptanceCriteria: The question remains exactly “Will you be my Valentine?” with the two buttons “👉 YES 💖” and “👉 NO 😠”.
First NO shows the angry boy-with-glasses animation + the exact text “Wrong answer! Try again 😤”, then returns to the question automatically.
Second NO fades out and becomes unclickable/disabled.
YES triggers a celebratory overlay that includes hearts plus star and moon elements before advancing to Page 4.

requirements.text: Update Page 4 to show a happy dancing cartoon boy with glasses (not bunny/panda) and display the text exactly “You just made me the happiest person alive!  💞” (including the double space before the emoji as provided), with a sparkly Continue button.

quotes: Page 4– Happy cutiee boy with glasses Show a happy dancing animation with text: “You just made me the happiest person alive!  💞” Add a “Continue” button with sparkles.

acceptanceCriteria: Page 4 uses boy-with-glasses imagery and no bunny/panda references in visuals or alt text.
The displayed sentence matches exactly “You just made me the happiest person alive!  💞”.
Continue button is present and includes sparkly styling/animation.

requirements.text: Keep Page 5 (Love Letters Gallery) as 6 clickable envelope/letter cards; each opened letter must include: (1) a pasteable photo placeholder, (2) the caption under the photo in this exact order: “My favorite smile”, “My happy peace”, “My forever girl”, “My heart”, “My life”, “My future wifey”, and (3) an editable notes box for writing a personal note; include a “Continue ❤️” button.

quotes:
Page 5 – Love Letters Gallery Display 6 large love letters side-by-side... A placeholder frame where I can paste her photo ... captions ... And with photo also add a box for where a can write notes for her 
Button: Continue ❤️

acceptanceCriteria: There are exactly 6 letter cards, each opens on click with a cute opening animation and floating hearts.
Each opened letter contains a pasteable photo area and a notes input/textarea.
Captions match the specified text exactly and are shown in the specified order.
A “Continue ❤️” button advances to Page 6.

requirements.text: Update Page 6 (Kiss) to the “cute boy with glasses” theme: show a boy with glasses blowing kisses animation; fade in the text exactly “If I could, I’d kiss you a thousand times right now 💋 ” (including the trailing space shown), with soft heart particles floating in the background, and a Continue button.

quotes:
Page 6 – Kiss Show a cute boy  with glasses blowing kisses animation. Text fades in: “If I could, I’d kiss you a thousand times right now 💋 ” Soft heart particles floating in background.
Continue button.

acceptanceCriteria: Boy-with-glasses kiss imagery is used (no bunny/panda).
Text matches exactly “If I could, I’d kiss you a thousand times right now 💋 ”.
Soft heart particle background is visible (with reduced-motion fallback preserved).
Continue advances to Page 7.

requirements.text: Update Page 7 (Proposal) to the “cute boy with glasses” theme: show a boy with glasses kneeling with a ring animation; update the proposal question text exactly to “Will you marry me in future? 💍”; provide exactly two affirmative buttons: “👉 Of course ❤️” and “👉 Always ❤️”; selecting either shows a cute happy boy-with-glasses celebration accent then advances to Page 8.

quotes:
Page 7 – Proposal A boy with glasses kneels with a ring animation. Big romantic text:
“Will you marry me in future? 💍”
Buttons: 👉 Of course ❤️
👉 Always ❤️
No negative option. Only love. With na cute animation on Happy boy with glasses

acceptanceCriteria: The proposal text matches exactly “Will you marry me in future? 💍”.
Only two buttons are shown: “👉 Of course ❤️” and “👉 Always ❤️”; no negative option exists.
On selection, a celebration accent plays briefly, then navigation proceeds to Page 8.

requirements.text: Keep Page 8 as the moonrise envelope/letter reveal sequence and ensure it remains editable (user can type anything), then provide a Continue button to advance.

quotes:
Page 8 - Then she selected yes a letter box open
With moon rise animation and and a page appear from insida the letter envelope where I can edit or write any thing

acceptanceCriteria: A moonrise scene appears, the envelope opens, and a letter emerges.
The letter contains an editable text area.
Continue advances to Page 9.

requirements.text: Refactor the current final page so Page 9 is a dedicated “Custom Message” page (with a cute boy-with-glasses animation on the page), containing a glowing text box labeled exactly “My message to you…”, floating hearts, and the romantic ending line exactly “Forever yours.” (without extra emoji).

quotes:
Page 9 – cute boy animation on page with Custom Message A beautiful final page where I can type my own message. Create a glowing text box labeled:
“My message to you…”
Add floating hearts and a romantic ending line:
“Forever yours.”

acceptanceCriteria: Page 9 shows a boy-with-glasses visual element/animation.
The heading/label is exactly “My message to you…”.
The ending line is exactly “Forever yours.” (no additional emoji).
The Love Story animation content is not shown on Page 9 (it is moved to Page 10).

requirements.text: Add a new Page 10 that presents a full animated story sequence in a beautiful cartoon style that depicts: long-distance → love → marriage → family with 5 children. The story must be viewable on mobile and must respect reduced-motion preferences (no auto-advance when reduced motion is enabled).

quotes: Page 10  -  a full animation story of long distance to love marriage to family of 5 childs with beautiful cartoon way.

acceptanceCriteria: Page 10 exists as its own page in the slideshow after Page 9.
The story sequence clearly includes a family outcome that corresponds to 5 children.
When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, the story does not auto-advance (manual navigation is still possible).

requirements.text: Add a new Page 11 closing screen that displays the text exactly “Happy Valentine Day my love my future wifey” and includes an editable note box where the user can write a final note.

quotes: Page 11 - happy valentine day my love my future wifey and also add a note box where I can write a last note

acceptanceCriteria: Page 11 shows the text exactly “Happy Valentine Day my love my future wifey”.
A visible editable note box is present and accepts typing.
Page 11 is reachable as the last page of the slideshow.

requirements.text: Update the pre-Page 1 intro animation to match the requested theme “Happy Valentine Day love with hearts” while keeping the existing reduced-motion fallback behavior intact.

quotes: First intro animation of happy valentine day love with hearts

acceptanceCriteria: The pre-intro overlay visually emphasizes a Valentine theme with hearts and includes “Happy Valentine Day” as part of the animation’s displayed text or prominent visual treatment.
When prefers-reduced-motion is enabled, the pre-intro completes near-instantly (maintaining current minimal-motion behavior).

requirements.text: Remove remaining bunny/panda references from user-facing copy and alt text across all pages being updated, and standardize the experience to a consistent “cute boy with glasses” theme throughout.
acceptanceCriteria: No screen updated in this request shows “bunny”/“panda” in visible user-facing strings or primary character image alt text.
All character visuals used across Pages 3–7 and Page 9 are consistent with the boy-with-glasses theme.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not route images through the backend; use static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated.
nonGoals: Adding persistence or saving the typed messages/notes to the backend.
Adding third-party authentication providers (Internet Identity integration is unchanged).
Changing the existing background music autoplay-gating behavior beyond ensuring it still works with the new pages.
